messages.text: how does it compare to the p2

The Q.1 is 8 TH/s at $248; the Thor P2 is 10 TH/s at $369. The P2 hashes more, the QX1 costs less per dollar up front.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?
Searched the catalog · NEXUS QX1 Hammer Thor P2 BC04

For a second unit, efficiency is the thing: the P2 does 10 TH/s on ~166 W, the QX1 8.1 TH/s on ~170 W. Same power draw, more hash, and quieter at ~40 dB. The Q.1's edge is only the $121 lower price, and it's a pre-order (ships October 15, 2026) while the P2 is buyable now.

What do you pay per kWh? I'll run both at your rate.
i have a bsb NerdOctaxe how does it compare to the p2

Close cousins. Your NerdOctaxe runs about 9.4 TH/s on 160–220 W; the P2 does ~10 TH/s on ~166 W. So adding a P2 roughly doubles your hashrate at similar efficiency — it's another unit, not a step up.

If you want a real jump, the Harlo B30 is ~30 TH/s at $899. Want me to run the numbers on both at your power rate?

The 12 TH/s is the overclocked figure — the listing says 9.4 TH/s typical, up to 12 TH/s at ~(address hidden) the P2 sits close: 10 TH/s on ~166 W, so about the same joules per terahash, just in a second box.
